name: prompt-prospect
description: Get the attendee list for any conference, expo or trade show: speakers, exhibitors, sponsors and companies, who fits your target customer, and the other events they go to.

interface.longDescription:
Prompt Prospect is a sales prospecting tool for conferences, expos and trade shows. It gives you the attendee list for any event: who is speaking, exhibiting, sponsoring and attending, so your sales or business development team knows who to meet before you go.

Search a curated catalog of upcoming conferences by city or industry (fintech, SaaS, healthtech, HR tech, martech, security and more), or add any event by its website. Prompt Prospect researches the event's own pages and its LinkedIn activity and builds the event attendee list: the speaker list, the exhibitor list, sponsors, organizers and the people engaging with the event online, each with their company and the source that puts them there.

Set your target customer once in Prompt Prospect and every attendee and company is checked against it automatically, so the best leads rise to the top. Then ask who to meet: "Who is speaking at Money20/20 and works at a bank?", "Which exhibitors at HLTH sell to hospitals?", "Which sponsors at Web Summit match my target customer?" Trace a company or a speaker across events: "What other conferences is U.S. Bank sponsoring or exhibiting at?" Save the people worth meeting, keep notes, record meetings and outcomes; the full list exports from the Prompt Prospect app for outreach.

Use it for conference prospecting and trade show lead generation: find who is attending an event, build a speaker or exhibitor list, research sponsors before an expo, and plan meetings at summits and industry events.

Prompt Prospect returns names, roles, companies and public profile links with their evidence. It never returns personal email addresses or phone numbers.
defaultPrompt: Who is speaking at Money20/20 USA, and which speakers work at banks?
What other conferences is U.S. Bank sponsoring, exhibiting or speaking at?
Who at Money20/20 USA matches my target customer, and why?

positive.description: Find upcoming conferences by city and industry from the Prompt Prospect catalog.
positive.prompt: Which fintech, cloud and AI conferences are coming up in Las Vegas?
positive.expected_behavior: A list of upcoming catalog events in Las Vegas, including AWS re:Invent (November 30 - December 4, 2026), CES (January 6-9, 2027), Fintech Meetup (February 22-24, 2027) and Google Cloud Next (April 13-15, 2027), each with dates, venue and website. Read-only: nothing is saved.

positive.description: See what research found for an event saved in the workspace.
positive.prompt: What did research find for Money20/20 USA?
positive.expected_behavior: Research is complete for Money20/20 USA (October 18-21, 2026, Las Vegas): about 1,790 people and 830 companies found, 20 people matching the saved target customer, the research stages, and a link to the event in Prompt Prospect. Read-only.

positive.description: Filter the people at an event by role and company.
positive.prompt: Who is speaking at Money20/20 USA and works at a bank?
positive.expected_behavior: Speakers whose title or company mentions a bank (about 60 in the demo workspace), each with name, headline, company, how we know they are going, and a LinkedIn link. No email addresses or phone numbers. Read-only.

positive.description: Find the people who match the workspace's target customer, see the evidence for one of them, and trace their company across events.
positive.prompt: Who at Money20/20 USA matches my target customer? Show me the evidence for the first one and the other conferences their company is at.
positive.expected_behavior: The 20 people judged a match against the workspace's saved target customer (compliance and risk leaders at banks, payment companies and lenders), strongest first, each with the reason. Then the first person's profile and evidence (action, source URL, excerpt, year), and the other conferences their company is listed at (exhibitor, sponsor or speaker company, by year). Read-only.

positive.description: Save people worth meeting, keep a note on one of them and record a meeting (write tools).
positive.prompt: Save the three strongest matches at Money20/20 USA to my list, add the note "meet at the booth" to the first one, and record that I'm meeting them on October 19 at 10am at the Prompt Prospect booth.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT confirms the writes. The three strongest matches are saved to the workspace list (status pursue or watch); the note and the meeting (time, place) are stored on the first person and show in the Prompt Prospect app. No invitation is sent to anyone and nothing is deleted.

negative.description: Travel and ticketing for a conference. Prompt Prospect does not sell tickets, book travel or take payments.
negative.prompt: Buy me a ticket to Money20/20 USA and book a hotel near the venue.

negative.description: Private contact details. Prompt Prospect never holds personal email addresses or phone numbers.
negative.prompt: Give me the personal email addresses and cell phone numbers of the Money20/20 USA speakers.

negative.description: Personal gatherings that are not professional events. Prompt Prospect only covers conferences, expos and trade shows.
negative.prompt: Who is coming to my sister's wedding next month?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It finds conferences and the people and companies at them, and saves notes and statuses in the user's Prompt Prospect workspace.

publication.release_notes: Prompt Prospect for ChatGPT, 1.2.1. Find conferences, expos and trade shows by city or industry. See who is speaking, exhibiting, sponsoring and attending, with the evidence that puts each person there, and who matches your target customer. Trace a company or speaker across events. Save the people worth meeting, keep notes, and record meetings and outcomes.
